failedPredecessorSelection.reason: R20 post-pair fixture flags yielded no exact distinct controls and cannot be reused as an R25 pre-candidate holder-mask control selector.

soleHolderNegative.rule: Select the lexical-first zero-pair held case having a channel-local image-derived holder span in both BF and DF, at least one raw candidate excluded by an overlapping local holder span, and no retained paired notch candidate.

notchAdjacentHolderControl.rule: Select the lexical-first unique non-fixture retained notch whose mean angle is 2.0 to 12.0 degrees from the nearest channel-local image-derived holder-span boundary in both BF and DF, with the retained notch outside every excluded span.
